team.tactical_role: Burn and offensive debuffs with direct fire damage
Anti-setup ice attacker with defensive preparation
Attack and speed control, recovery, and ground immunity pivot

strategy_notes.zh: 里奥斯用烧伤和封印削弱攻势；布林克斯消除强化；巴洛卡降低攻击与速度，并用栖息恢复。保留直接攻击，抓住对手受限的回合进攻。 对方全员 Lv.80、个体值 31、学习力合计 510、实干性格；仅使用本形态在 80 级前学会的四个技能，体力和能力按普通精灵公式计算。可自由使用道具，胜利获得赛尔豆与经验。

source_note: Original remake trainer composition using retained catalog species and naturally learned level-80-or-earlier skills. This is not a recovered historical boss encounter. No HP overrides, stat multipliers, additional rules, or unlimited PP are used.
